entry.author: Christchurch City Libraries
entry.summary:
Nau mai haere mai ki Te Kāhui Ōhua!
Te Kāhui Ōhua is a casual, monthly reading group that celebrates our Ngā Pounamu Māori Collection. 

Each month you’ll choose any book from the collection to read - Fiction or Non-Fiction, in English or Te Reo - and share your reads with the rest of the group. 

All are welcome, bring the whānau!

The group meets on the last Friday of the month from 5.30pm to 6.30pm at Ngā Pounamu Māori Collection | Waruwarutū, Tuakiri | Level 2, Tūranga. 
https://christchurch.bibliocommons.com/v2/events?series=692e2f201b0dca3d00df4bb1
